emerging_conditions.narrative: A fire-weather pattern is developing over CO: Denver city, Aurora city, Thornton city, Arvada city, and Greeley city and 18 other communities sit under an active Red Flag Warning or Watch. USGS fire-danger models put the local large-fire/spread probability as high as 6% in spots. No fire has been reported yet, but the combination of dry fuels and elevated fire weather is exactly the kind that produces a fast-moving run if an ignition occurs.
